summary: Azerion is dutch video game company, founded in 2016. Type: startup / scale-up. About 839 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 1 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Azerion is an Amsterdam-listed digital advertising and games company; an IND sponsor whose current internship mentions visa support and needs no Dutch.

culture.text: About 839 people on LinkedIn, mostly in sales, business development and marketing, with commercial teams in over 26 cities.
Staff studied marketing, communication, business and economics, at schools like Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences and Complutense Madrid.
Founded in 2014 by two Dutch entrepreneurs and headquartered in Amsterdam.

open.text: Several Azerion entities, including Azerion Tech Holding B.V., are IND recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a product internship in Amsterdam, needs no Dutch and mentions visas.

growth.text: H1 2026 profits were stronger, but Azerion cut its revenue outlook for 2026.
Q2 2026 revenue fell 5.9% while EBITDA rose 2.7%.
Took over Bauer Media France's advertising sales and won Venatus as a technology partner.

worth_knowing.text: Merged the sales departments of Azerion, mJourney and RLVNT, and bundled its publisher business under Improve Digital.
Applied to list bonds on Nasdaq Stockholm after its prospectus was approved.
